This pattern affects cards like C05560-K2 and was uncovered through Sentinel sweep alerts identifying rapid bursts of near-threshold transactions.

sar.narrative: Customer C05560, holding card C05560-K2, was identified in a fraud investigation involving suspicious online transactions. A series of 4 card transactions totaling $1,799.79 was executed between 2016-12-05 and 2016-12-06. The activity occurred online across channels involving desktop and mobile device profiles. The method utilized structuring, wherein multiple purchases were made in rapid succession with amounts kept just under the $500 threshold to evade standard controls. This behavior is highly suspicious and consistent with fraudulent structuring tactics observed in prior connected cases. The customer also has 8 earlier confirmed fraud cases including CC-5150, CC-1587, CC-5020, CC-3466, and CC-1210. Recommended actions for this case include blocking the card, creating a case, and filing a report.
